svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Focus on a chosen task versus an assigned one
svg.desc: Stylized chart of attention on the same task over its first hours. Chosen work holds a high, flat line because friction reads as a puzzle and pings get deflected. Assigned work decays in a sawtooth because every notification becomes a permission slip to leave, and attention that leaves is not pulled back, so hours stretch into days.
svg.text: the same task, over its first hours
I chose it: friction reads as a puzzle, pings get deflected
I did not choose it: every notification is a permission slip to leave
attention leaves and nothing pulls it back, so hours stretch into days
